hero.label: Made for Garage
hero.headline: I want to help Garage become the go-to marketplace for essential industries.
hero.subheadline: Firefighting equipment is exactly the kind of unsexy, critical market that creates durable businesses. Garage is solving a real logistics and liquidity problem for departments that can't afford inefficiency. I want to be one of the first people on the phone making that market.

whyCompany.title: Critical assets in essential industries are massively underserved by modern commerce
whyCompany.body: Fire departments across the country are buying and selling used gear through word of mouth, spreadsheets, and luck. Garage is bringing structure and trust to a market that has never had a proper exchange. That is a real problem worth solving, and the timing for a marketplace built on reliability is exactly right.

whyCompany.title: Being an early sales hire at a marketplace startup is a rare opportunity
whyCompany.body: Garage is at the stage where every call matters and every closed deal shapes how the company thinks about its sales motion. That means the person in this role has direct influence on product, messaging, and process, not just quota. I want to be in that room while it is still being built.

whyCompany.title: My BDR experience maps directly to what this role requires on day one
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch, built HubSpot sequences, and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients in a market where no one had heard of us. Selling into fire departments and municipalities is a trust-first sale to buyers who are skeptical of new vendors, which is exactly the environment I trained in. I know how to earn a first conversation and turn it into a pipeline.

quote: I grew up around soccer teams that had nothing and made it work. Garage is doing the same thing for fire departments, and I want to be the person convincing them to trust something new.
